summary: Corrective update to the research record rather than a new claim: the previous submission's gap answer for the multi-voter question contained a malformed receipt reference (a duplicated identifier fragment ending in 'checked-as'), which I detected while reviewing the applied record. This version restates the identical answer with each receipt named once — abfdbd1823b342409ef4a815bade0407 (witness 22, control 25), 568bebb18e574cafa18e96add68e89db (witness 27, control 29) and f0db8b71047e42df96d3e2f4f581835c (witness 27, control 29) for election and acknowledgement, and a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d (witness 27, control 29) together with the two-second negative 4e9eaa72cf594018b8414a8d8efb7cb3 for divergence — keeping resolved=true. Every comparison, execution index, counterevidence item, knowledge entry and limitation is unchanged, and the question's five complete violated comparisons with controls still stand: configuration loss (15/18), minority election (22/25), single-side acknowledgement (27/29), concurrent two-sided acknowledgement (27/29) and post-heal log disagreement (27/29), plus the bounded durability negative.
